description: Source code for the client component of the Emergency Access Daemon, implementing network communication, authentication, and command execution.

methods.name: set_nonblock
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode based on the enable parameter.

methods.name: send_packet
methods.description: Sends a packet of specified type and handles responses with a handler function, up to a maximum number of responses.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Prepares the password for authentication, applying MD5 hashing if required.

methods.name: handle_pong
methods.description: Handles pong responses from the server, updating authentication state.

methods.name: handle_prime
methods.description: Handles prime and salt exchange for authentication.

methods.name: handle_b
methods.description: Handles reception of a number message.

methods.name: handle_cmd_data
methods.description: Handles command data received from the server.

methods.name: send_ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to discover active devices.

methods.name: get_prime
methods.description: Requests prime and salt for authentication.

methods.name: send_a
methods.description: Sends the client's public key component.

methods.name: send_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the server.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.
